Newsletter Designs

The newsletter template changes colour with the kit QPR wear: blue for home games, pink for away games and green for the third kit. QPR FC Women have their own version.

Guess the Score

A prediction competition I created for QPR supporters. Before every match, fans guessed the score for the chance to win prizes. Each graphic was made in the colours of the kit QPR were wearing: blue for home, pink for away, green for the third kit.

Jul 2026

Last week marked the end of my placement year with the Marketing Team at QPR FC.

What an incredible year it's been. Over the 2025/26 season, working as a Marketing & Supporter Services Assistant, I've learnt so much about what goes into marketing a football club and had the chance to be part of the behind the scenes.

From creating my own campaigns and running supporter events during the season to controlling the Big Screen and Instagram Stories on matchdays, every opportunity has taught me something new and helped me grow within the field and as a person.

I've also been lucky enough to work with such an amazing group of people who have made this experience so enjoyable throughout.

A special thank you to Ed Barber, Chloe Tong, and Daniel Laryea for all your support, guidance, and everything you've taught me over the past year. It's been a pleasure working with you.

As I head back to Loughborough University for my final year, I'll be taking with me so many great memories and valuable experiences from my time at the club.

Mar 2026

Last week's fixture against Blackburn Rovers saw the club hold its annual Junior Hoops Takeover Day, and I had the privilege of planning and delivering the experience.

I worked with multiple club departments to give five young R's fans behind the scenes access across media, retail, hospitality, and ticketing.

They completed a range of tasks including commentary, stadium announcing, content creation, ticket printing, and welcoming hospitality guests. They then finished the day by meeting Julien Stéphan and receiving their certificates.

Leading the initiative was incredibly rewarding, it strengthened my leadership skills and adaptability in the fast-paced matchday environment, while also helping create an unforgettable experience for our young supporters.

Dec 2025

As 2025 comes to an end, it's a great moment to reflect on my first six months at QPR FC. It has been an incredible start to my placement, which began in July.

Since joining the club, I've had the opportunity to contribute to a range of marketing and fan engagement initiatives, both on and off the pitch.

Some highlights so far include:

  • Creating and delivering the Guess the Score fan engagement campaign on one of the club's social media channels
  • Organising and supporting Junior Hoops events to strengthen connections with our younger supporters
  • Leading the matchday operation for our last home fixture against Leicester City
  • Delivering first-time fan experiences ahead of every home match
  • Creating interactive activities for junior supporters, including a Which Player Am I game and a QPR General Knowledge Quiz
  • Planning and executing our 12 Days of Christmas giveaway, rewarding supporters in the run-up to the festive period

I'm proud to have contributed to projects that have helped deepen my understanding of the football industry, grow within my role and mature as a person.

Looking ahead to the new year, I'm excited to learn even more and gain further hands on experience in my time remaining at the club! ⚽ 💙

Nov 2025

Last Thursday, I had the incredible opportunity to manage my first event at QPR FC, our Junior Hoops Halloween event at TOCA Social: Trick or TOCA Social! 👻

We invited thirty Junior Hoops to join us at the Westfield venue, dressed in their scariest costumes, to take part in interactive football games and compete for prizes! ⚽

Players from the Development Squad also joined us to play alongside the kids, answer questions and sign autographs, making it a memorable afternoon for our young supporters.

Leading the event from marketing and planning to on the day coordination was such a great learning experience, and hearing all the positive feedback afterwards made every bit of effort worthwhile.

A massive thank you to everyone at QPR and TOCA Social White City who helped make the event such a success. Already excited to start planning for our Christmas event! 🎅

Jul 2025

My first month at QPR FC has been incredible. I would like to thank everyone in the club for being so nice and welcoming. In particular, Alex Wormald for your help and introduction to the role, as well as Ed Barber, Chloe Tong and Daniel Laryea for helping me settle in within the Marketing team.

The handover guided me through the roles and responsibilities I will have this upcoming season. These include using applications such as Two Circles to target supporters for our newsletters and solus' and Crowd Manager for fan engagement campaigns.

Since then I have had the responsibilities of:

  • Building Weekly Social Newsletters and Solus' previewing QPR matches, events and updates
  • Providing first time fan experiences for our pre-season friendlies against SC Heerenveen and Brentford
  • Admin for the attendance and questions for the Fans' Forum and Club Competitions
  • Assisting with the marketing of the club's home, away and third kit launches

I'm proud to announce that I will be joining QPR FC as a Marketing and Supporter Services Assistant for the 2025/26 season.

It's a tremendous honour to spend my placement year from Loughborough University at such an established and successful football club. In this role, I will use my skills and experience to help the club enhance the fan experience through digital marketing communications and customer relations.

I'd like to thank Ed Barber and Chloe Tong for this incredible opportunity and their support throughout the process. I'm excited to be joining the team and contribute to QPR's ongoing success!
